Ai Weiwei Whoops!

2014
Web-based game, social media integration

Ai Weiwei Whoops! is a browser game made after Maximo Caminero walked into the Pérez Art Museum Miami in February 2014 and dropped one of Ai Weiwei’s Colored Vases (2006–12) on the floor, citing Ai’s own Dropping a Han-Dynasty Urn (1995) as inspiration. Ai denounced the act, and news reports put the vase’s value near a million dollars. In the game, the cursor becomes a vase, and each click sends one crashing to the ground in a burst of pixels, adding between $900,000 and $1.1 million to a running total of “approximate property damage.” There are no levels and no goal, only a tally that climbs past anything payable. Ai objected to the destruction of his property; the game asks whether he would object to the destruction of its image.
